idea-plugin.name: GSC Language Server
idea-plugin.description:
Language support for Call of Duty GSC (game script, IW3 and IW4) through a language server: code completion, hover documentation, signature help, go to definition, semantic highlighting, parameter name inlay hints, a color picker for color vectors and TextMate syntax highlighting.

Configure it under Settings | Languages & Frameworks | GSC. Without configured root directories, the project folder is used.

server.name: GSC Language Server
server.description: Language server for Call of Duty GSC (game script).
